messages:
rafa: Heads-up launch week checklist for the webinar + benchmark pages. Main asks: keyword-target list for each page, anchor text plan for internal links, CDN redirects (and rollback), and HubSpot mapping. Who's free to split?

lee: I can take keywords + anchor text. Quick plan: primary keyword per page + 3 secondary longtails. Example for benchmark page:
- primary: "inference benchmark latency cost"
- secondaries: "LLM inference cost comparison", "GPU latency benchmarks 2024"
Anchor text priorities: hero -> "Latency & cost benchmark"; compare table -> "See model breakdown"; CTA -> "Join the webinar".

anika: I'll own redirects + HubSpot. Redirect rules live at CDN edge (Fastly). For rollback we push a revert tag that nukes the redirect VCL on failure. Example _redirects style for Netlify that we will stage:
```
/old-bench /benchmarks/latency-cost-2024 301
/webinar/register  /webinars/inference-launch 302
```
Also, HubSpot mapping: query param `src=webinar_launch` -> `hubspot_property:campaign_source` and hidden field `landing_page_id`.

infra-bot: Staging scan results: https://ci.reports/redwood/1732109999/scan - issues found: 2 broken anchors on /benchmarks/latency-cost-2024, missing Dataset schema on benchmark results, and OG image missing alt text.

rafa: Ok @lee please pick up the 2 broken anchors (likely id mismatch). @anika, make the redirect rollback playbook explicit in the sheet. Also need canonical strategy: do we canonicalize tags pages to category or keep discrete? Thoughts?

lee: Prefer canonical to category for old tag aggregations that are thin. For benchmark we canonicalize to the long-form landing: `<link rel=\"canonical\" href=\"https://redwood.com/benchmarks/latency-cost-2024\">`. For webinar snippets on blog posts, use `rel=\"alternate\"` to avoid duplication.

anika: I've added rollback steps: (1) deploy redirect, (2) smoke test staging, (3) deploy to prod, (4) if error revert to previous VCL and invalidate CDN cache. Added stopgap 302 for first 15m to monitor metrics before switching to 301.

lee: Adding schema snippets for the benchmark: use `Dataset` + `SoftwareSourceCode` for harness and `CreativeWork` for the results summary. Small JSON-LD example for the dataset metadata:
```json
{ "@context":"https://schema.org", "@type":"Dataset", "name":"Inference latency-cost dataset", "url":"https://redwood.com/benchmarks/latency-cost-2024/data.csv" }
```
Include `citation` linking to repo commit.

ops: Quick note on inbound routing: HubSpot form GUID for webinar is `hs_789xyz`. I've hooked test webhook to staging; it pushes to pipeline `marketing-webinars`. Ensure we have `utm_campaign` -> `campaign_name` mapping, otherwise source attribution will be lost.

rafa: Great. Final items before go: 1) keywords + meta (lee) 2) schema + OG fixes (lee) 3) redirects + rollback plan deploy (anika) 4) HubSpot mapping + webhook test (ops). We meeting tomorrow 9am PT for final QA. If all green, ship Wed 10:00 PT. :spiral_calendar_pad:
